_comment: Activates brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin (Claude Code hook and CI). The repo is English, so the German-only copy rules are off: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7), gender forms (A11) and German UI texts (C5). Em dashes as connectors (A2), spellings (A10), the anti-slop patterns (S*), palette, token and dark-mode rules stay on. The docs kit in docs/.vitepress/miragon/ is linted at its source in Miragon/corporate-identity. The code in src/, test/ and tools/ is not linted: its colours are the colours of BPMN diagrams (the bpmn-js colour picker that `bpmn color` writes into a model, the halos and badges of `bpmn render`), data of the models, not the brand.
